**Last night of the old warren.**
Tonight's 22:00 duel closes season 2. At 06:00 tomorrow the new roster lands and every horde starts from nothing.
Want in on Monday's first duel? Open the game, recruit a few rats, and your board joins the league by itself. Have it ready by 21:30: boards are taken just before the duel.
Who builds the first Rot-Chemist board?
